senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; ספף , v. סוּף, to cut, hollow out; also to put ends together, join)

bowl. Mekh. Bo, s. 6 (ref. to Ex. XII, 22) מניד הכתוב … ואין סף אלא אסקופה the text intimates that he loosens and digs a hole on the side of the threshold and slaughters over it, for saf means (a cavity made in) the threshold.
units: Ib. אין סף אלא כלי saf means a vessel; Y. Pes. IX, 36ᵈ bot., sq.

senses.gloss: pl. סִפִּים, סִפִּין, סִי׳ [cut stones, cmp. גָּזִית,] paving-blocks, stone-pavement.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45</cite> <he>והס׳ נבקעין וכ׳</he> and the blocks burst before them (the frogs).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 105">Midr. Till. to Ps. CV, 30</cite> <he>בתי הס׳</he> houses which had stone pavements; (Yalk. ib. 820 <he>פספסין</he>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 10">Ex. R. s. 10</cite> <he>פסיפס</he>).
